text:
ana-security: Heads-up: anomaly from internal SSH CA (ca-ssh-01) 30 detected ~100 certs issued in ~12m. Treat as suspected compromise. Follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-incident
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert ca-signature-rate-detector evt=ca-2432109876. Baseline ~1/min, observed ~9/min.
lena-sre: Oncall. Confirmed spike in audit log and pod stdout. Stopping signing endpoint now. Will open a 30-45m maintenance window.
mike-eng: Blast radius quick-check: bastion, deploy-runners, infra-hosts, kube-ssh-proxy, ci-workers. Notifying owners.
prateek-devex: I'll prepare an automated revoke+reissue playbook (canary -> 25% -> 100%). Will need serial list and revocation token. Draft in internal repo.
nana-security: Containment checklist: 1) Disable signing endpoint; 2) Export serial list; 3) Publish temp CRL to s3://redwood-ssh-crl/incident-2432 and set clients to poll every 60s; 4) Create new HSM key (label ca-ssh-rot-2432) and update CA metadata; 5) Revoke affected leaf certs and reissue short-ttl certs.
lena-sre: Commands to gather evidence: `systemctl stop ssh-ca || pkill -f ssh-ca; journalctl -u ssh-ca --since "-30m" | grep "issued" > /tmp/ca_issued.log; grep -o "serial=[0-9a-f]\+" /var/log/ssh-ca/audit.log | sed 's/serial=//' | sort -u > /tmp/issued_serials.txt`
mike-eng: Pausing pipelines that require new certs. Using jump-emergency-1 for critical access.
sec-bot: Policy reminder: SEC-KEY-ROT-2: legal+exec notification required if private key compromise confirmed. Open ticket TKT-INC-243210-SSHCA and update status.
nana-security: Assigning leads: @lena-sre (ops), @prateek-devex (automation), @mike-eng (coord). Security will own post-incident review.
lena-sre: Live checklist in ticket: [x] stop service, [x] export serials, [x] publish temp CRL, [ ] create HSM key, [ ] push CA metadata, [ ] revoke leaf certs, [ ] reissue short-ttl certs, [ ] validate CI & hosts, [ ] exec/legal notify if required.
prateek-devex: Playbook ready in ticket, will request approval for full fleet run in 15m.
nana-security: Keep all sensitive data out of public channels; use incident template for comms. Postmortem to follow. :lock:
